content: Bepaŋdi metam hogohi yehimoŋgo-fooŋ metam didimehi hogok yehitubu-lodalak
Yahwe, du Bepaŋ doktiŋa metam kadakaniŋhinitdok kibikoŋ malabumuŋ didimeniŋgoŋ yembeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa kwihitage u tubumintaune kaneŋ.
Agaŋ mu pilataŋ! Kwet diniŋ mede yodapmandapmaŋ, du pilali me foko tiiŋ hekidok kibikoŋ titiŋhik wendok tuwolit tubu-udaneyembeŋ.
Me kadakahidi titiŋhikdok nadifo nai dedigoŋ hinek tineŋ? Yahwe, nai dedigoŋ hinek hayemilak?
Nai dedigoŋ hinek hayembune me hogohi adi kadakaniŋ tigiŋ wendok foko tiŋa nadifo tineeŋ?
Yahwe, adi yadi metamgeye yehimoŋgofooŋ malabumuŋ wapum hinek yemiiŋ.
Adi yadi tam kahat eŋ wapmihi kondiŋahi eŋ metam niŋkadehi indi’walaŋ kwetnineŋ iŋoŋ hatiiŋ u widihi kumuŋ tiiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋila indiŋ yoiŋ, “Yahwe adi tuwot mu nibilak. Eŋ Isilaehi’walaŋ Bepaŋ adi nemek i tiyam wendok nadibedi mu tilak.”
Metamneye, hidi detiŋa kudi kauleŋ unduŋ tiiŋ? Bubuyehi hidi, nai deniŋ nadinadihinit tineeŋ?
Bepaŋdi magitnik tutumbaguk, unduŋ doktiŋa adi tuwot mube nadiwek? Tiŋa undugoŋ, Bepaŋdi daunik tutumbaguk, unduŋ doktiŋa adi tuwot mube diwetomuŋa kawek?
Adi metambop yenindokodokoyelak, unduŋ doktiŋa yehitubu-didime tuwot mube tibek? Tiŋa undugoŋ, adi yadi metam hogohogok’walaŋ henalehik, unduŋ doktiŋa adi nadinadinit mokit be?
Yahwe adi metam hogohogok’walaŋ nadinadihik u agaŋ nadidapmalak. Unduŋ doktiŋa nadinadihik u kudige nabugoŋ liwelak, u agaŋ nadilak.
Yahwe, du me niŋ nindokodokoyeŋ Yodoko Medege nintubudidime tubune me u Bepaŋ’walaŋ kahaŋ kaŋ nadifo kedem tibek.
Du indiŋ doktiŋa unduŋ tilaŋ: adi malabumuŋ mu minta-mimbune kulemaŋgoŋ hatikulema tilune me kadakahi adi koŋ gineŋ foneeŋ.
Maŋgande, Yahwe adi metamŋiye tuwot mu biyabek. Biyagoŋ hinek, adi metamŋiye netok gigit tigiŋ adi sigilulum tuwot mu tiyembek.
Kaŋ mindaŋkade mede nadinadi me mede kwanai tineeneŋ mede agaŋ didimeŋgoŋ hogok yodapmaneeŋ. Kaŋ metam didimehi adi u kaune tuwot hinek tibaak.
Nediyendi nehitubu-lodaaŋ me kadakahi yehimoŋgofoguk? Eŋ nediyeŋdi nehitubu-lodaaŋ me yom tiiŋ u yehikelekukuk?
Yahwedi mu binek nehitubu-lodawe tuguk binek adi agaŋ pilap hinek meyotneŋ gwaŋ dahatit.
Nu indiŋ nadigut, “Kayone agaŋ sulukeneto tilak, ala agaŋ maaŋ nutuwek.” Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Yahwe, du nutok bulaniŋgoŋ hinek nadinamuŋa nohoneune nu kadakaniŋ gineŋ mu maaŋ nutak.
Tiŋa undugoŋ, nu welemulap nadiŋa nemenemekdok nadinadi fee tilat, kaŋ dagoŋ welene tubukulemaaŋ nadifo tubuminta-namulaŋ.
Du adi talitimeŋ kadakahi dut mu kwanainelaŋ. Meheki woŋ adi yodoko mede indiŋ kameiŋ, metam adi kadakaniŋ kedem titiŋdok.
Adi yadi me momooŋ tubukadakadok bopneeŋ yofolok tiiŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ, me yom nemu tiiŋ iŋgoŋ widihikumuŋ titiŋdok nadiŋa mede gineŋ hogok yapmefit tiiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ Yahwedi fafaŋe hinek tiŋa nehitubu-lodalak. Bepaŋnedi momooŋ hinek nabudokolak.
Adi titiŋ kadakahi fee hinek tigiŋ, unduŋ doktiŋa kibibo yomhidok toboniŋ tubu-udaneyembek. Adi kadakaniŋhik u nadisuŋa widihi-kumuŋ tibek. Yahwe Bepaŋnikdi yehitubu-kadakadapmaŋ tibek.
